items.stem:
Read the revision note prepared by a Class 9 student on "Income, expenditure and making a personal budget" and answer the questions that follow.
"A popular rule suggests spending 50 per cent on needs, 30 per cent on wants and (A) ______ per cent on savings. Food, shelter and medicines are examples of (B) ______."
(i) Fill in blank (A). (1 mark)
(ii) Fill in blank (B). (1 mark)
(iii) Why should a family make a budget? (2 marks)
items.answer: (i) 20 (ii) needs (iii) (1) To spend within its income. (2) To plan savings for future needs and emergencies.
items.markingKey: (i) 20 – 1 mark. (ii) needs – 1 mark. (iii) any two points, 1 mark each: (1) To spend within its income. (2) To plan savings for future needs and emergencies.

items.stem: State whether the statement is True or False. If false, correct it: Food, shelter and medicines are examples of wants.
items.answer: False. Food, shelter and medicines are examples of needs.
